The season began on January 30 and ended on December 18, with a break in July for the [[2011 Copa América]]. [[Liga Deportiva Universitaria de Quito|LDU Quito]] is the defending champion. ==Format== After a session of the preliminary meeting of the Congress of Professional Football of the [[Ecuadorian Football Federation]] ({{langx|es|Congreso Ordinario del Fútbol Profesional de la Federación Ecuatoriana de Fútbol}}), it was determined that the format for the 2011 season will be the same as the [[2010 Campeonato Ecuatoriano de Fútbol Serie A#Format|previous season]].{{cite web |url=http://www.futbolecuador.com/stories/publica/18314 |title=Concluyó el Pre-Congreso |language=es |trans-title=The Pre-Congress Concluded |publisher=futbolecuador.com |date=January 6, 2011 |access-date=January 7, 2011 }} ==Teams== Twelve teams will compete in the 2011 Serie A season, ten of whom remain from the previous season. [[Club Social y Deportivo Macará|Macará]] and [[Club Deportivo Universidad Católica del Ecuador|Universidad Católica]] were relegated last season after accumulating the fewest points in the [[2010 Campeonato Ecuatoriano de Fútbol Serie A#Aggregate table|2010 season aggregate table]]. They were replaced by [[Liga Deportiva Universitaria de Loja|LDU Loja]] and [[Imbabura Sporting Club|Imbabura]], the 2010 [[Ecuadorian Serie B|Serie B]] winner and runner-up, respectively.{{cite web |url=http://www4.elcomercio.com/Generales/Solo-Texto.aspx?gn3articleID=279868 |title=Liga de Loja retorna a la Serie A tras 5 años |language=es |trans-title=Liga de Loja returns to the Serie after 5 years |first=Manuel |last=Quizhpe |date=November 13, 2010 |access-date=November 21, 2010 |publisher=[[El Comercio (Ecuador)|El Comercio]] }}{{Dead link|date=November 2018 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}{{cite web |url=http://www4.elcomercio.com/Generales/Solo-Texto.aspx?gn3articleID=282277 |title=Imbabura ganó a la UTE y clasificó para jugar en la Serie A del 2011 |language=es |trans-title=Imbabura beat UTE and qualified for the 2011 Serie A |date=November 27, 2010 |access-date=November 28, 2010 |publisher=[[El Comercio (Ecuador)|El Comercio]] }}{{Dead link|date=November 2018 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} This will be both clubs' second season in the league.
